source_title: Great Books #10: Dante's Hierarchy of Hell
summary: This April 29, 2026 Dante lecture has already become public Free Will and atlas evidence: hell is imagination turned against itself, redemption cannot be forced, and love becomes the limit that leaves another soul's choice uncoerced.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Hell is the imagination turned inward when blocked love and blocked self-forgiveness make the soul build its own prison, and nobody can redeem that soul by force.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The episode read already links this mark to the public Free Will anchor, and the concept page already carries the dated Inferno formulation.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Cato cannot force Marcia into purgatory because love has to leave the beloved's redemption, self-reflection, and choice unforced.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The atlas already uses this source to distinguish Human Heart recognition from Free Will noncoercion.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Already public: use this source as the Inferno version of Free Will's burden, where sin, imagination, risk, redemption, and self-forgiveness make human creativity possible, while hell is chosen and self-sustained when imagination turns against love.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Free Will owns the agency and redemption mechanism. Human Heart owns love as relation and recognition; Dead World owns the cave/prison ontology only when mediated false reality is primary.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Already public: this source supports the atlas boundary between recognition and noncoercion, because love can make another person visible without giving the lover authority to force salvation.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: The atlas relation should keep routing love-language by active mechanism: Human Heart for concrete recognition, Free Will for the refusal to override agency.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Hold Ugolino's blindness-to-love sequence for a future Love Recognizes The Other replacement pass: betrayal becomes perceptual damage, so even a child's final act of love appears as food.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Love Recognizes The Other owns the failure to see a concrete person as beloved. Free Will owns self-made hell; Taboo or Stories should not absorb this unless future sources foreground transgression grammar or viral transmission.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Hold the Lucifer/Virgil/Cato contradiction sequence for a future Guide Trap replacement or compression pass: Lucifer is demoted into a mechanical cold-maker, while Virgil looks like the hidden authority whose map fails before Cato.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Guide Trap owns hidden guide authority and failed mediation. Dead World owns dead mechanism only if the future synthesis is about mechanized reality rather than Virgil's authority.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use the deception-virus line only as comparison evidence for Story Virus unless another source repeats the full infection, disinhibition, and institutional-transmission chain.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: This source gives a moral-psychology metaphor for deception spreading, but it does not by itself justify a standalone Story Virus child page.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use the Dante-never-read-Homer convergence only when Poetry or Great Books method is being revised: Jiang treats Homer and Dante as independently discovering the same machinery of love, trauma, return, and imagination.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Poetry owns cross-text world-making method; Human Heart and Free Will own the love and redemption mechanisms carried by the method.

new_lens_seeds.title: Treachery Blinds Love
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: Betrayal trains perception until chosen bonds, children, guests, and love itself appear only as danger, appetite, or usable material.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: The Ugolino sequence is strong enough to name, but the existing Love Recognizes The Other and Free Will pages can carry the mechanism until more sources need a narrower hover.
new_lens_seeds.boundary_note: Hold as a seed. A public page would duplicate Love Recognizes The Other unless future sources repeatedly center betrayal as perceptual blindness rather than one Inferno scene.

new_lens_seeds.title: Lucifer As Dead Mechanism
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: The apparent sovereign of evil is not a romantic rebel or mastermind but a dead mechanical force whose motion keeps the prison cold.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: This could later bridge Dead World, Guide Trap, Eschatology, and Free Will, but the current source mainly uses it to expose Virgil's hidden authority and the self-made character of hell.
new_lens_seeds.boundary_note: Do not create a Lucifer or Satan page from this source. Route by active mechanism: Guide Trap for hidden authority, Dead World for dead mechanism, Eschatology for sacred role-script, Free Will for agency.

chronology_notes.note: Dated 2026-04-29, this lecture is the mature Inferno layer after the 2026-04-08 chosen-hell formulation and before the 2026-05-22 Purgatorio self-forgiveness layer: chosen hell becomes self-imagined prison, then purgatory becomes chosen cleansing.

chronology_notes.concept: Human Heart / Free Will atlas boundary
chronology_notes.note: The Cato-Marcia passage gives a dated anti-coercion formulation: love requires restraint because even someone who loves another person cannot make that person's soul choose ascent.

This lecture sits between the 2026-04-08 Virgil guide-trap formulation and the 2026-05-22 Statius lamp formulation by making the Inferno's contradictions point back toward Virgil's authority rather than Lucifer's sovereignty.

next_actions.action: Do not create standalone Hell, Lucifer, Satan, Ugolino, Cato, Marcia, Treachery, Dante #10, Sin Makes Creativity, or Love As Divine Spark pages from this source alone.

If public synthesis follows, prefer a Love Recognizes The Other replacement/compression pass around treachery as blindness to love, or a Guide Trap replacement pass around Lucifer-as-machine and Virgil's hidden authority; do not append ordinary Dante evidence to already dense parent pages.

Keep the existing episode-to-lens links to lens-point:free-will-self-made-hell-needs-self-redemption; only add more links if a future concept pass creates or chooses a stable Love Recognizes or Guide Trap anchor specific enough for Ugolino or Cato.
